decision_windows.U: unlabeled candidate construction; freeze the candidate afterward
decision_windows.V: unlabeled decision evidence; no residual fitting with target outcomes
decision_windows.E: fresh evaluation inputs are used for frozen predictions; evaluation outcomes are joined only after the entire predeclared action and prediction sets are sealed
decision_windows.C: historical labeled calibration environments, separate from U/V/E target episodes

outcome_custody.user_request: Assistant manages labels outside the repository and uses them only at the authorized scoring stage; no manual collaborator custody required.
outcome_custody.vault_requirements: Dedicated owner-enforcing filesystem outside the repository and scientific worker allowlists; no reliance on ExFAT chmod semantics.
outcome_custody.access_contract: A fixed ingestion broker may parse label-bearing input privately and export only allowlisted opaque metadata. Restricted source/development, decision and prediction workers receive only their authorized views. The fixed offline scorer validates the complete lock, action set, prediction set, metric and run state before opening target labels.
outcome_custody.scoring_contract: All predeclared actions and predictions must be sealed before any target score. One complete join, no interactive subset scoring, no adapter/plugin execution in the label-capable scorer, and no return channel to later decisions.
outcome_custody.failure_contract: Failed sandbox preflight stops execution. Any failure after a target label read permanently records opened/incomplete status; it must not reset the study to unopened.
outcome_custody.threat_model: Protect the configured scientific workers against accidental or unauthorized label reads. Does not prevent the broadly authorized host assistant, account owner or administrator from deliberately bypassing the workflow.
